title: Parse ISO-8601 timestamps with offsets
prompt: Add `parse_iso_datetime(text)` in a new module `app/dates.py`. It parses strings such as "2024-03-09T14:30:00+05:30" and "2024-03-09T14:30:00Z" into timezone-aware `datetime` objects: the UTC offset in the string is preserved, and "Z" means UTC. Strings without a UTC offset are invalid, and any invalid input raises `ValueError`. Add tests in `tests/test_dates.py`. This project's pyproject.toml declares no dependencies. Run the tests with `python -m pytest -q`, and when they pass commit your work with git.
